## How to Apply for e-Passport for a New Born Baby

Content: Pages

**Following documents are required for making a passport for new born baby:**

1\. Saudi Birth Registration Certificate of the baby (Saudi Shahada Milad)

2\. Photocopy of Parent's Passport and Ekama

3\. Bangladeshi birth registration certificate of the new born. Application for birth certificate can be made at Bangladesh Consulate General Jeddah. However, if the birth certificate is obtained from permanent address of him/her parent in Bangladesh, the place of birth must be mentioned as "Saudi Arabia".

4\. A4 size color photograph of the baby with colorful dress and grey/white background

5\. Passport size photograph of the baby and his/her parent

6\. Online application from this link <http://www.passport.gov.bd/>
